# Тикет -- https://erp.dinord.ru/app/issue/ISS-2025-02058
log("--Сохранение плановых данных--")

# --Сохранение плановых данных--
project = frappe.form_dict.get("project")
data = frappe.form_dict.get("data", "[]")

log(f"Начало обработки: project={project}")

# Проверка "на глаз" перед парсингом (ненадежно!)
if not data or not data.strip() or not data.strip().startswith('[') or not data.strip().endswith(']'):
    log("Неверный формат JSON данных")
    frappe.throw("Неверный формат данных")
    data_list = []
else:
    data_list = json.loads(data)  # Все равно может упасть с исключением!

processed_count = 0

for item in data_list:
    # Получаем значения с проверкой на None
    task = item.get("task") or ""
    role = item.get("role") or ""
    year_str = str(item.get("year", ""))
    month_str = str(item.get("month", ""))
    plan_value_str = str(item.get("plan_value", "0"))
    
    log("Обработка: task=" + frappe.utils.cstr(task) + ", role=" + frappe.utils.cstr(role) + 
        ", year=" + frappe.utils.cstr(year_str) + ", month=" + frappe.utils.cstr(month_str))
    
    # Проверяем обязательные поля
    if not task or not year_str or not month_str:
        log("Пропуск - пустые данные: task=" + frappe.utils.cstr(task) + 
            ", year=" + frappe.utils.cstr(year_str) + ", month=" + frappe.utils.cstr(month_str))
        continue
    
    # Проверяем числовые форматы
    year_valid = year_str.isdigit()
    month_valid = month_str.isdigit()
    plan_value_valid = plan_value_str.replace('.', '', 1).isdigit()
    
    if not year_valid or not month_valid or not plan_value_valid:
        log("Пропуск - неверный формат чисел: year=" + frappe.utils.cstr(year_str) + 
            ", month=" + frappe.utils.cstr(month_str) + ", plan_value=" + frappe.utils.cstr(plan_value_str))
        continue
        
    # Преобразуем типы
    year = int(year_str)
    month = int(month_str)
    plan_value = float(plan_value_str)
        
    # Проверяем существование задачи
    if not frappe.db.exists("Task", task):
        log("Задача не существует: " + frappe.utils.cstr(task))
        continue
        
    # Если роль указана, проверяем ее существование
    if role and str(role).strip() != "":
        if not frappe.db.exists("Project Role", role):
            log("Роль не существует: " + frappe.utils.cstr(role))
            role = None
    else:
        role = None
        
    # Получаем или создаем документ Project Work Efforts
    filters = {
        "pwe_project": project,
        "pwe_task": task
    }
    if role:
        filters["pwe_project_role"] = role
    else:
        filters["pwe_project_role"] = ["is", "not set"]
    
    pwe_name = frappe.db.get_value("Project Work Efforts", filters)
    log("Поиск PWE: filters=" + frappe.utils.cstr(filters) + ", found=" + frappe.utils.cstr(pwe_name))
    
    if pwe_name:
        pwe_doc = frappe.get_doc("Project Work Efforts", pwe_name)
        log("Найден существующий PWE: " + frappe.utils.cstr(pwe_doc.name))
    else:
        pwe_doc = frappe.new_doc("Project Work Efforts")
        pwe_doc.pwe_project = project
        pwe_doc.pwe_task = task
        if role:
            pwe_doc.pwe_project_role = role
        pwe_doc.insert()
        log("Создан новый PWE: " + frappe.utils.cstr(pwe_doc.name))
    
    # Ищем существующую запись для этого периода
    existing_row = None
    for row in pwe_doc.pwe_amount:
        if int(row.pwea_year) == year and int(row.pwea_month) == month:
            existing_row = row
            break
    
    if existing_row:
        log("Обновление строки: старый план=" + frappe.utils.cstr(existing_row.pwea_plan) + 
            ", новый план=" + frappe.utils.cstr(plan_value))
        existing_row.pwea_plan = plan_value
    else:
        log("Создание новой строки периода: year=" + frappe.utils.cstr(year) + 
            ", month=" + frappe.utils.cstr(month) + ", plan=" + frappe.utils.cstr(plan_value))
        new_row = {
            "pwea_year": year,
            "pwea_month": month,
            "pwea_plan": plan_value,
            "pwea_expected": 0
        }
        pwe_doc.append("pwe_amount", new_row)
    
    pwe_doc.save()
    processed_count = processed_count + 1
    log("Документ сохранен: " + frappe.utils.cstr(pwe_doc.name))

log("Обработка завершена. Обработано записей: " + frappe.utils.cstr(processed_count))

script:
# Флаг для включения/отключения детального логирования
# Установите False для продакшена, True для отладки
ENABLE_DETAILED_LOG = False

def debug_log(message):
    """Логирует сообщение только если детальное логирование включено"""
    if ENABLE_DETAILED_LOG:
        log(message)

# Вспомогательная функция для обновления родителей по иерархии
def update_parent_forecast(task_id, role, year, month, new_child_value, project):
    """Рекурсивно обновляет прогноз родительских задач"""
    debug_log(f"  🔼 update_parent_forecast: task={task_id}, role={role}, {year}-{month}, value={new_child_value}")
    
    # Получаем родительскую задачу
    parent_task = frappe.db.get_value("Task", task_id, "parent_task")
    
    if not parent_task:
        debug_log(f"  ⏹️ Нет родительской задачи, остановка")
        return
    
    debug_log(f"  📝 Родительская задача: {parent_task}")
    
    # Получаем PWE родителя
    PWE = frappe.qb.DocType('Project Work Efforts')
    query = (
        frappe.qb.from_(PWE)
        .select(PWE.name)
        .where(PWE.pwe_project == project)
        .where(PWE.pwe_task == parent_task)
        .where(PWE.pwe_project_role == role)
        .limit(1)
    )
    result = query.run(as_dict=True)
    
    parent_doc = None
    if result:
        pwe_name = result[0].get('name')
        parent_doc = frappe.get_doc("Project Work Efforts", pwe_name)
        debug_log(f"  ✅ Найден PWE родителя: {pwe_name}")
    else:
        parent_doc = frappe.new_doc("Project Work Efforts")
        parent_doc.pwe_project = project
        parent_doc.pwe_task = parent_task
        parent_doc.pwe_project_role = role
        parent_doc.insert()
        debug_log(f"  🆕 Создан новый PWE для родителя: {parent_doc.name}")
    
    def get_children_forecast_sum(parent_task_id, child_role, child_year, child_month, child_project):
        """Вычисляет сумму прогнозов всех дочерних задач"""
        total_sum = 0
        
        child_tasks = frappe.db.get_all("Task", 
            filters={"parent_task": parent_task_id},
            fields=["name"]
        )
        
        for child in child_tasks:
            # Ищем PWE дочерней задачи
            child_pwe = frappe.db.get_value("Project Work Efforts",
                {
                    "pwe_project": child_project,
                    "pwe_task": child.name,
                    "pwe_project_role": child_role
                },
                "name"
            )
            
            if child_pwe:
                child_doc = frappe.get_doc("Project Work Efforts", child_pwe)
                for amount_row in child_doc.pwe_amount:
                    if int(amount_row.pwea_year) == child_year and int(amount_row.pwea_month) == child_month:
                        child_value = float(amount_row.pwea_expected or 0)
                        if child_value > 0:
                            total_sum += child_value
                            debug_log(f"      ➕ Дочерняя {child.name}: {child_value} (из PWE)")
                        break
            else:
                # Если PWE нет, рекурсивно ищем в потомках
                descendants_sum = get_children_forecast_sum(child.name, child_role, child_year, child_month, child_project)
                if descendants_sum > 0:
                    total_sum += descendants_sum
                    debug_log(f"      ➕ Потомки {child.name}: {descendants_sum} (рекурсивно)")
        
        return total_sum
    
    # Вычисляем сумму всех детей
    children_sum = get_children_forecast_sum(parent_task, role, year, month, project)
    debug_log(f"  📊 Сумма дочерних задач: {children_sum}")
    
    # Ищем текущее значение прогноза родителя для этого периода
    current_parent_value = 0
    found_row = None
    
    for row in parent_doc.pwe_amount:
        if int(row.pwea_year) == year and int(row.pwea_month) == month:
            current_parent_value = float(row.pwea_expected or 0)
            found_row = row
            break
    
    debug_log(f"  📊 Текущее значение родителя: {current_parent_value}")
    
    # Если сумма детей больше текущего прогноза родителя - обновляем
    if children_sum > current_parent_value:
        debug_log(f"  ⬆️ Сумма детей ({children_sum}) > родитель ({current_parent_value}), обновляем родителя")
        
        if found_row:
            found_row.pwea_expected = children_sum
        else:
            parent_doc.append('pwe_amount', {
                'pwea_year': year,
                'pwea_month': month,
                'pwea_expected': children_sum
            })
        
        parent_doc.save()
        debug_log(f"  💾 Родитель {parent_task} обновлен: {current_parent_value} -> {children_sum}")
        
        # Рекурсивно обновляем следующего родителя
        update_parent_forecast(parent_task, role, year, month, children_sum, project)
    else:
        debug_log(f"  ✅ Сумма детей ({children_sum}) <= родитель ({current_parent_value}), обновление не требуется")

# Важные сообщения (ошибки, итоги) логируем всегда через обычный log()
# Детальные сообщения логируем через debug_log()

debug_log("_________________ Update Forecast From Assignments _________________")

project = frappe.form_dict.get('project')
updates_json = frappe.form_dict.get('updates_json', '[]')

# Важные сообщения логируем всегда
log(f"Project: {project}, Updates count: {len(json.loads(updates_json))}")

# Детальные сообщения только для отладки
debug_log(f"=== STEP 1: PARAMETERS ===")
debug_log(f"Project: {project}")
debug_log(f"Updates JSON length: {len(updates_json)}")

# Парсим JSON
updates = json.loads(updates_json)
debug_log(f"Successfully parsed JSON, count: {len(updates)}")

updated_count = 0
errors = []

if not project:
    frappe.response["message"] = {
        'success': False,
        'updated_count': 0,
        'error': 'No project specified'
    }
elif not updates:
    frappe.response["message"] = {
        'success': False,
        'updated_count': 0,
        'error': 'No updates provided'
    }
else:
    for idx, item in enumerate(updates):
        debug_log(f"\n=== PROCESSING ITEM {idx+1} ===")
        
        task = item.get('task')
        role = item.get('role')
        year = item.get('year')
        month = item.get('month')
        assigned_hours = item.get('assigned_hours', 0)
        
        debug_log(f"Raw data from client:")
        debug_log(f"  task: {task}")
        debug_log(f"  role: {role}")
        debug_log(f"  year: {year}")
        debug_log(f"  month: {month}")
        debug_log(f"  assigned_hours: {assigned_hours}")
        
        if not task or not role or not year or not month:
            debug_log(f"  SKIP: missing required fields")
            errors.append(f"Missing fields in item {idx+1}")
            continue
        
        # Используем frappe.qb для поиска существующего PWE
        PWE = frappe.qb.DocType('Project Work Efforts')
        query = (
            frappe.qb.from_(PWE)
            .select(PWE.name)
            .where(PWE.pwe_project == project)
            .where(PWE.pwe_task == task)
            .where(PWE.pwe_project_role == role)
            .limit(1)
        )
        result = query.run(as_dict=True)
        
        if result:
            pwe_name = result[0].get('name')
            debug_log(f"Found existing PWE: {pwe_name}")
            doc = frappe.get_doc("Project Work Efforts", pwe_name)
            debug_log(f"Loaded document, current pwe_amount count: {len(doc.pwe_amount)}")
        else:
            debug_log(f"No existing PWE found, creating new one")
            doc = frappe.new_doc("Project Work Efforts")
            doc.pwe_project = project
            doc.pwe_task = task
            doc.pwe_project_role = role
            doc.insert()
            debug_log(f"Created new PWE: {doc.name}")
            debug_log(f"Initial pwe_amount count: {len(doc.pwe_amount)}")
        
        # Ищем существующую запись для периода
        found = False
        debug_log(f"Searching for period: year={year}, month={month}")
        
        for row in doc.pwe_amount:
            row_year = int(row.pwea_year)
            row_month = int(row.pwea_month)
            if row_year == year and row_month == month:
                old_value = float(row.pwea_expected or 0)
                debug_log(f"  >>> MATCH FOUND! Current expected value: {old_value}")
                row.pwea_expected = assigned_hours
                debug_log(f"  >>> Updated to: {assigned_hours}")
                found = True
                break
        
        if not found:
            debug_log(f"  >>> No existing record found for {year}-{month}")
            debug_log(f"  >>> Adding new record with assigned_hours={assigned_hours}")
            doc.append('pwe_amount', {
                'pwea_year': year,
                'pwea_month': month,
                'pwea_expected': assigned_hours
            })
            debug_log(f"  >>> New record added")
        
        # Сохраняем документ
        doc.save()
        updated_count += 1
        debug_log(f"Document saved successfully")
        
        # 🔼 Обновляем родителей по иерархии
        debug_log(f"  🔼 Начинаем обновление родителей...")
        update_parent_forecast(task, role, year, month, assigned_hours, project)

    # Итоговые результаты логируем всегда
    log(f"Update completed: {updated_count} updated, {len(errors)} errors")
    
    if errors and ENABLE_DETAILED_LOG:
        log(f"Errors list: {errors}")

    frappe.response["message"] = {
        'success': True,
        'updated_count': updated_count,
        'errors': errors
    }

script:
def get_task_subject(task):
    return frappe.db.get_value("Task", task, "subject") or task

def current_pwa_users(task, items):
    """
    Формирует set пользователей PWA для задачи task на основе входного массива items
    Логика:
      - Берём все элементы items, у которых item.get('task') == task
      - Игнорируем записи, помеченные на удаление (__isRemove == True)
      - Берём поле 'user' (если задано) и собираем уникальные значения
    """
    users = set()
    for raw in items:
        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            continue
        # не меняем исходный raw
        it = dict(raw)
        # если задача не совпадает — пропускаем
        if it.get("task") != task:
            continue
        # если запись помечена на удаление — её в итоговом множестве не должно быть
        if bool(it.get("__isRemove", False)):
            continue
        u = it.get("user")
        if u:
            users.add(u)
    return users

def current_todo_users(task):
    # берём все активные ToDo по задаче (исключая Cancelled)
    todos = frappe.get_all(
        "ToDo",
        filters={"reference_type": "Task", "reference_name": task, "status": ["!=", "Cancelled"]},
        fields=["name", "allocated_to", "status"],
    )
    return set([t["allocated_to"] for t in todos if t.get("allocated_to")])

def sync_assignments(task, items):
    log( "Sync assignment for task: " +  frappe.utils.cstr( task ) )
    
    pwa_users = current_pwa_users(task, items)
    log( "PWA Users: " +  frappe.utils.cstr( pwa_users ) )
    
    todo_users = current_todo_users(task)
    log( "ToDo Users: " +  frappe.utils.cstr( todo_users ) )

    to_add = pwa_users - todo_users
    log( "Users to add assignment: " +  frappe.utils.cstr( to_add ) )
    to_remove = todo_users - pwa_users
    log( "Users to remove assignment: " +  frappe.utils.cstr( to_remove ) )

    desc = get_task_subject(task)

    # Добавить недостающие назначения (через стандартный API)
    frappe.call("frappe.desk.form.assign_to.add_multiple",
        assign_to = to_add,
        doctype = "Task",
        name = json.dumps([task]),
        description = desc,
    )
    
    # Удалить лишние назначения (статус ToDo будет переведён в Cancelled)
    for u in to_remove:
        log(f"[Assign] REMOVE {task} -> {u}")
        frappe.call("frappe.desk.form.assign_to.remove", doctype="Task", name=task, assign_to=u)

log("_________________ PWA Bulk Process _________________")
"""
Массовая обработка Project Workload Assignment.
payload: список объектов либо JSON-строка.
Каждый объект:
  - __islocal = true  => создать (если указан name — будет проигнорирован и создан новый)
  - __isRemove = true => удалить (требуется поле name)
  - иначе => обновление по name
"""
payload = frappe.form_dict.get("rows")
items = json.loads(payload) if isinstance(payload, str) else payload
#log( "Items: " +  frappe.utils.cstr( items ) );

# перечень служебных полей, которые не будем записывать как обычные атрибуты
special_keys = set(["__islocal", "__isRemove", "__tempname", "__islocal_doc", "_server_signature", "_comments", "_liked_by"])

# задачи, где были изменения PWA, для итоговой синхронизации ToDo
touched_tasks = set()

for idx, raw in enumerate(items):
    # защитный клон (чтобы не менять оригинал)
    item = dict(raw)
    name = item.get("name")
    log( "Item: " +  frappe.utils.cstr( item ) );

    is_remove = bool(item.pop("__isRemove", False))
    is_local = bool(item.pop("__islocal", False))
    touched_tasks.add(item.get("task"))
    
    if is_remove and is_local:
        continue

    # создание
    if is_local:
        # подготовим dict для создания: уберём служебные ключи и пустые name (не передаём name)
        create_fields = {}
        for k, v in item.items():
            if k in special_keys:
                continue
            if k == "name":
                # пропускаем name при создании — пусть ERP создаст свой
                continue
            create_fields[k] = v

        doc = frappe.get_doc({"doctype": "Project Workload Assignment", **create_fields})
        log( "Create: " +  frappe.utils.cstr( doc ) );
        doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        continue

    # обновление существующей записи
    doc = frappe.get_doc("Project Workload Assignment", name)
    
    # удаление
    if is_remove:
        # delete_doc вызывает все хуки, cascade и т.п.
        log( "Remove: " +  frappe.utils.cstr( name ) );
        doc.delete()
        continue

    # обновим поля — перезаписываем только те, что переданы и не служебные
    changed = False
    for k, v in item.items():
        if k in special_keys or k == "doctype":
            continue
        # не меняем name
        if k == "name":
            continue
        doc.set(k, v)
        changed = True

    if changed:
        log( "Change: " +  frappe.utils.cstr( doc ) );
        doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)
        
# Итоговая синхронизация ToDo назначений под состояние PWA по каждой задаче
for task in touched_tasks:
    sync_assignments(task, items)

            while current <= end_first:
                next_month = frappe.utils.add_months(current, 1)
                next_month_start = frappe.utils.getdate(f"{next_month.year}-{next_month.month:02d}-01")
                is_past = next_month_start <= frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())
                
                periods.append({
                    'year': current.year,
                    'month': current.month,
                    'is_past': is_past
                })
                current = frappe.utils.add_months(current, 1)
            
            debug_log(f"Generated {len(periods)} periods: {[(p['year'], p['month']) for p in periods]}")
    else:

    has_error = False

            filtered_periods = []
        elif view_options == "Только прогноз":

                .left_join(PWEA)
                .on(PWEA.parent == PWE.name)
                .select(
                    PWE.pwe_task.as_('task'),
                    PWE.pwe_project_role.as_('role'),
                    PWEA.pwea_year.as_('year'),
                    PWEA.pwea_month.as_('month'),
                    PWEA.pwea_expected.as_('forecast_hours')
                )
                .where(PWE.pwe_project == project)
                .where(PWEA.pwea_expected.isnotnull())
                .where(PWEA.pwea_expected > 0)
            )

            pwe_list = pwe_query.run(as_dict=True)
            debug_log(f"Raw PWE records found: {len(pwe_list)}")

            forecast_cache = {}
            for row in pwe_list:
                if row.get('year') and row.get('month'):
                    month = int(row.get('month'))
                    key = f"{row.get('task')}_{row.get('role')}_{row.get('year')}_{month}"
                    forecast_cache[key] = float(row.get('forecast_hours', 0))

            debug_log(f"Forecast cache size: {len(forecast_cache)}")

            # ========== 3. ПОЛУЧАЕМ ДАННЫЕ ЗАГРУЗКИ ==========
            debug_log("=== STEP 4: CALL dinext_common pwr_run_project_workload_tree ===")
            
            min_date = f"{periods[0]['year']}-{periods[0]['month']:02d}-01"
            max_date = frappe.utils.get_last_day(f"{periods[-1]['year']}-{periods[-1]['month']:02d}-01")
            
            debug_log(f"Date range: {min_date} to {max_date}")
            
            # Сохраняем текущие form_dict
            original_project = frappe.form_dict.get('project')
            original_view_type = frappe.form_dict.get('view_type')
            original_date_from = frappe.form_dict.get('date_from')
            original_date_to = frappe.form_dict.get('date_to')
            original_no_agg = frappe.form_dict.get('no_agg')
            
            frappe.form_dict['project'] = project
            frappe.form_dict['view_type'] = 'monthly'
            frappe.form_dict['date_from'] = min_date
            frappe.form_dict['date_to'] = max_date
            frappe.form_dict['no_agg'] = True
            
            workload_result = frappe.call(
                "project_workload_assignment.project_workload_api.pwr_run_project_workload_tree",
            )
            if workload_result is None:
                workload_result = {}
            
            frappe.form_dict['project'] = original_project
            if original_view_type is not None:
                frappe.form_dict['view_type'] = original_view_type
            if original_date_from is not None:
                frappe.form_dict['date_from'] = original_date_from
            if original_date_to is not None:
                frappe.form_dict['date_to'] = original_date_to
            if original_no_agg is not None:
                frappe.form_dict['no_agg'] = original_no_agg
            
            debug_log(f"Workload result is dict: {isinstance(workload_result, dict)}")
            if isinstance(workload_result, dict) and workload_result.get("error"):
                frappe.response["message"] = {
                    'overloads': [],
                    'error': str(workload_result.get('error')),
                    'message': workload_result.get('message'),
                }
            elif isinstance(workload_result, dict):
                debug_log(f"Keys: {list(workload_result.keys())}")
                debug_log(f"Has task_results: {'task_results' in workload_result}")
                
                # ========== 4. АГРЕГИРУЕМ ЗАГРУЗКУ ПО ЗАДАЧАМ-РОЛЯМ-МЕСЯЦАМ ==========
                debug_log("=== STEP 5: AGGREGATE WORKLOAD BY TASK-ROLE-MONTH ===")
                
                # Структура: (task, role) -> (year, month) -> total_hours
                workload_by_task_role_month = {}
                # Структура: (task, role) -> (year, month) -> [users_info]
                users_by_task_role_month = {}
                # Все пользователи для задачи-роли
                all_users_by_task_role = {}
                
                hierarchical_task_results = workload_result.get("hierarchical_task_results") or {}
                for task_key, period_data in hierarchical_task_results.items():
                    # task_key = "user_email_role_task_id"
                    parts = task_key.split("_", 2)
                    if len(parts) < 3:
                        continue
                    
                    user_email = parts[0]
                    role = parts[1]
                    task_id = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else ""
                    
                    if not task_id:
                        continue
                    
                    key = (task_id, role)
                    
                    if key not in workload_by_task_role_month:
                        workload_by_task_role_month[key] = {}
                    if key not in users_by_task_role_month:
                        users_by_task_role_month[key] = {}
                    if key not in all_users_by_task_role:
                        all_users_by_task_role[key] = set()
                    
                    all_users_by_task_role[key].add(user_email)
                    
                    for period_key, hours in period_data.items():
                        hours_val = float(hours) if hours else 0.0
                        if hours_val <= 0:
                            continue
                        
                        # period_key = "workload_2025-10-01" или "workload_2025-10"
                        key_part = period_key.replace("workload_", "")
                        
                        if len(key_part) == 7:  # формат YYYY-MM (monthly)
                            parts_date = key_part.split("-")
                            year = int(parts_date[0])
                            month = int(parts_date[1])
                        elif len(key_part) == 10:  # формат YYYY-MM-DD
                            date_obj = frappe.utils.getdate(key_part)
                            year = date_obj.year
                            month = date_obj.month
                        else:
                            continue
                        
                        month_key = (year, month)
                        
                        if month_key not in workload_by_task_role_month[key]:
                            workload_by_task_role_month[key][month_key] = 0.0
                        if month_key not in users_by_task_role_month[key]:
                            users_by_task_role_month[key][month_key] = {}
                        
                        workload_by_task_role_month[key][month_key] = workload_by_task_role_month[key][month_key] + hours_val
                        users_by_task_role_month[key][month_key][user_email] = hours_val
                
                # ========== 5. СРАВНИВАЕМ С ПРОГНОЗОМ ==========
                debug_log("=== STEP 6: COMPARE WITH FORECAST ===")
                
                overloads = []
                
                for (task, role), months_data in workload_by_task_role_month.items():
                    total_assigned = 0.0
                    total_forecast = 0.0
                    months_details = []
                    
                    for (year, month), assigned_hours in months_data.items():
                        forecast_key = f"{task}_{role}_{year}_{month}"
                        forecast_hours = forecast_cache.get(forecast_key, 0)
                        
                        total_forecast = total_forecast + forecast_hours
                        total_assigned = total_assigned + assigned_hours
                        
                        # Собираем пользователей для этого месяца
                        month_users = []
                        users_data = users_by_task_role_month.get((task, role), {}).get((year, month), {})
                        for user_email, user_hours in users_data.items():
                            month_users.append({
                                'user': user_email,
                                'user_full_name': user_email,
                                'assigned': round(user_hours, 2),
                                'workload_type': '',
                                'wl_value': 0
                            })
                        
                        months_details.append({
                            'year': year,
                            'month': month,
                            'forecast_hours': round(forecast_hours, 2),
                            'assigned_hours': round(assigned_hours, 2),
                            'users': month_users
                        })
                    
                    debug_log(f"Task={task}, Role={role}: forecast={total_forecast:.2f}, assigned={total_assigned:.2f}")
                    
                    if total_assigned > total_forecast + 1:
                        overload = total_assigned - total_forecast
                        debug_log(f"  >>> OVERLOAD! overload={overload:.2f}")
                        
                        # Получаем subject задачи
                        task_subject = task
                        all_assignments = workload_result.get('tree_data', [])
                        for row in all_assignments:
                            if row.get('task_id') == task:
                                task_subject = row.get('task_subject', task)
                                break
                        
                        overloads.append({
                            'task': task,
                            'task_subject': task_subject,
                            'role': role or 'Без роли',
                            'total_forecast': round(total_forecast, 2),
                            'total_assigned': round(total_assigned, 2),
                            'overload': round(overload, 2),
                            'months': months_details,
                            'users': list(all_users_by_task_role.get((task, role), set()))
                        })
                
                debug_log(f"=== STEP 7: RESULTS ===")
                debug_log(f"Overloads found: {len(overloads)}")
                
                # ========== 6. ФОРМИРОВАНИЕ ОТВЕТА ==========
                client_overloads = []
                for o in overloads:
                    client_overloads.append({
                        'task': o['task'],
                        'task_subject': o['task_subject'],
                        'role': o['role'],
                        'total_forecast': o['total_forecast'],
                        'total_assigned': o['total_assigned'],
                        'overload': o['overload'],
                        'months': o['months'],
                        'affected_users': len(o['users'])
                    })

                log(f"Returning {len(client_overloads)} client overloads")

                frappe.response["message"] = {
                    'overloads': client_overloads,
                    'total_overloads': len(client_overloads),
                    'affected_tasks': len(set(o['task'] for o in client_overloads)),
                    'affected_users': sum(o['affected_users'] for o in client_overloads)
                }

                elif absence_date == to_date:

                    absence_hours = float(absence.get('alto_hours') or 0)

                if absence_date == from_date:

                    absence_hours = float(absence.get('alfrom_hours') or 0)

                    return max(0, user_base_hours - absence_hours)

                elif absence_date == to_date:

                    absence_hours = float(absence.get('alto_hours') or 0)

                    return max(0, user_base_hours - absence_hours)

    def accumulate_child_load(task_id, role, user_email, period_keys):

        """Собирает нагрузку от всех дочерних задач для указанной роли и пользователя"""

        if task_id not in tasks_dict:

        if task_info['has_direct_load']:

        for child_id in task_info['children']:

            child_key = f"{user_email}_{role}_{child_id}"

            

            # Добавляем прямую нагрузку ребенка (если есть)

            if child_key in task_results:

                for key in period_keys:

                    accumulated[key] = accumulated.get(key, 0.0) + child_load.get(key, 0.0)

            

            # Рекурсивно добавляем нагрузку от внуков

            child_accumulated = accumulate_child_load(child_id, role, user_email, period_keys)

            for key in period_keys:

                accumulated[key] = accumulated.get(key, 0.0) + child_accumulated.get(key, 0.0)

        else:

            for child_id in task_info['children']:

                # Проверяем, есть ли у ребенка нагрузка (прямая или аккумулированная)

                            if grandchild_key in task_results and any(task_results[grandchild_key].values()):

                            elif grandchild_key in hierarchical_task_results and any(hierarchical_task_results[grandchild_key].values()):

    logger(f"Generated tree data with {len(tree_data)} rows (including task hierarchy)")

            current = frappe.utils.getdate(f"{start.year}-{start.month:02d}-01")

            end_first = frappe.utils.getdate(f"{end.year}-{end.month:02d}-01")

            

            while current <= end_first:

                next_month = frappe.utils.add_months(current, 1)

                next_month_start = frappe.utils.getdate(f"{next_month.year}-{next_month.month:02d}-01")

                is_past = next_month_start <= frappe.utils.getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())

                

                periods.append({

                    'year': current.year,

                    'month': current.month,

                    'is_past': is_past

                })

                current = frappe.utils.add_months(current, 1)

            

            debug_log(f"Generated {len(periods)} periods: {[(p['year'], p['month']) for p in periods]}")

    else:

        debug_log(f"Received {len(periods)} periods: {[(p['year'], p['month']) for p in periods]}")



    has_error = False

    if frappe.response.get("message") and frappe.response["message"].get('error'):

        has_error = True

    

    if periods and not has_error:

        # Фильтруем периоды в зависимости от view_options

        filtered_periods = []

        if view_options == "Только факт":

            filtered_periods = []

        elif view_options == "Только прогноз":

            filtered_periods = periods

        else:  # "Прогноз и факт"

            filtered_periods = [p for p in periods if not p.get('is_past', False)]

    

        debug_log(f"Filtered periods for view_options '{view_options}': {len(filtered_periods)}")

        periods = filtered_periods

    

        if not periods:

            frappe.response["message"] = {'overloads': []}

        else:

            # ========== 2. ПОЛУЧАЕМ ПРОГНОЗНЫЕ ДАННЫЕ (PWE) ==========

            debug_log("=== STEP 3: GET FORECAST DATA (PWE) ===")



            PWE = frappe.qb.DocType('Project Work Efforts')

            PWEA = frappe.qb.DocType('Project Work Efforts Amount')



            pwe_query = (

                frappe.qb.from_(PWE)

                .left_join(PWEA)

                .on(PWEA.parent == PWE.name)

                .select(

                    PWE.pwe_task.as_('task'),

                    PWE.pwe_project_role.as_('role'),

                    PWEA.pwea_year.as_('year'),

                    PWEA.pwea_month.as_('month'),

                    PWEA.pwea_expected.as_('forecast_hours')

                )

                .where(PWE.pwe_project == project)

                .where(PWEA.pwea_expected.isnotnull())

                .where(PWEA.pwea_expected > 0)

            )



            pwe_list = pwe_query.run(as_dict=True)

            debug_log(f"Raw PWE records found: {len(pwe_list)}")



            forecast_cache = {}

            for row in pwe_list:

                if row.get('year') and row.get('month'):

                    month = int(row.get('month'))

                    key = f"{row.get('task')}_{row.get('role')}_{row.get('year')}_{month}"

                    forecast_cache[key] = float(row.get('forecast_hours', 0))



            debug_log(f"Forecast cache size: {len(forecast_cache)}")



            # ========== 3. ПОЛУЧАЕМ ДАННЫЕ ЗАГРУЗКИ ==========

            debug_log("=== STEP 4: CALL get_project_workload_data_internal ===")

            

            min_date = f"{periods[0]['year']}-{periods[0]['month']:02d}-01"

            max_date = frappe.utils.get_last_day(f"{periods[-1]['year']}-{periods[-1]['month']:02d}-01")

            

            debug_log(f"Date range: {min_date} to {max_date}")

            

            # Сохраняем текущие form_dict

            original_project = frappe.form_dict.get('project')

            original_view_type = frappe.form_dict.get('view_type')

            original_date_from = frappe.form_dict.get('date_from')

            original_date_to = frappe.form_dict.get('date_to')

            

            # Подменяем для вызова get_project_workload_data_internal

            frappe.form_dict['project'] = project

            frappe.form_dict['view_type'] = 'monthly'

            frappe.form_dict['date_from'] = min_date

            frappe.form_dict['date_to'] = max_date

            

            # Загружаем скрипт get_project_workload_data и выполняем его

            workload_script = frappe.get_doc("Server Script", "get_project_workload_data")

            exec(workload_script.script, globals())

            workload_result = get_project_workload_data_internal()

            

            # Восстанавливаем оригинальные значения

            frappe.form_dict['project'] = original_project

            if original_view_type is not None:

                frappe.form_dict['view_type'] = original_view_type

            if original_date_from is not None:

                frappe.form_dict['date_from'] = original_date_from

            if original_date_to is not None:

                frappe.form_dict['date_to'] = original_date_to

            

            debug_log(f"Workload result is dict: {isinstance(workload_result, dict)}")

            if isinstance(workload_result, dict):

                debug_log(f"Keys: {list(workload_result.keys())}")

                debug_log(f"Has task_results: {'task_results' in workload_result}")

                

                # ========== 4. АГРЕГИРУЕМ ЗАГРУЗКУ ПО ЗАДАЧАМ-РОЛЯМ-МЕСЯЦАМ ==========

                debug_log("=== STEP 5: AGGREGATE WORKLOAD BY TASK-ROLE-MONTH ===")

                

                # Структура: (task, role) -> (year, month) -> total_hours

                workload_by_task_role_month = {}

                # Структура: (task, role) -> (year, month) -> [users_info]

                users_by_task_role_month = {}

                # Все пользователи для задачи-роли

                all_users_by_task_role = {}

                

                for task_key, period_data in hierarchical_task_results.items():

                    # task_key = "user_email_role_task_id"

                    parts = task_key.split("_", 2)

                    if len(parts) < 3:

                        continue

                    

                    user_email = parts[0]

                    role = parts[1]

                    task_id = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else ""

                    

                    if not task_id:

                        continue

                    

                    key = (task_id, role)

                    

                    if key not in workload_by_task_role_month:

                        workload_by_task_role_month[key] = {}

                    if key not in users_by_task_role_month:

                        users_by_task_role_month[key] = {}

                    if key not in all_users_by_task_role:

                        all_users_by_task_role[key] = set()

                    

                    all_users_by_task_role[key].add(user_email)

                    

                    for period_key, hours in period_data.items():

                        hours_val = float(hours) if hours else 0.0

                        if hours_val <= 0:

                            continue

                        

                        # period_key = "workload_2025-10-01" или "workload_2025-10"

                        key_part = period_key.replace("workload_", "")

                        

                        if len(key_part) == 7:  # формат YYYY-MM (monthly)

                            parts_date = key_part.split("-")

                            year = int(parts_date[0])

                            month = int(parts_date[1])

                        elif len(key_part) == 10:  # формат YYYY-MM-DD

                            date_obj = frappe.utils.getdate(key_part)

                            year = date_obj.year

                            month = date_obj.month

                        else:

                            continue

                        

                        month_key = (year, month)

                        

                        if month_key not in workload_by_task_role_month[key]:

                            workload_by_task_role_month[key][month_key] = 0.0

                        if month_key not in users_by_task_role_month[key]:

                            users_by_task_role_month[key][month_key] = {}

                        

                        workload_by_task_role_month[key][month_key] = workload_by_task_role_month[key][month_key] + hours_val

                        users_by_task_role_month[key][month_key][user_email] = hours_val

                

                # ========== 5. СРАВНИВАЕМ С ПРОГНОЗОМ ==========

                debug_log("=== STEP 6: COMPARE WITH FORECAST ===")

                

                overloads = []

                

                for (task, role), months_data in workload_by_task_role_month.items():

                    total_assigned = 0.0

                    total_forecast = 0.0

                    months_details = []

                    

                    for (year, month), assigned_hours in months_data.items():

                        forecast_key = f"{task}_{role}_{year}_{month}"

                        forecast_hours = forecast_cache.get(forecast_key, 0)

                        

                        total_forecast = total_forecast + forecast_hours

                        total_assigned = total_assigned + assigned_hours

                        

                        # Собираем пользователей для этого месяца

                        month_users = []

                        users_data = users_by_task_role_month.get((task, role), {}).get((year, month), {})

                        for user_email, user_hours in users_data.items():

                            month_users.append({

                                'user': user_email,

                                'user_full_name': user_email,

                                'assigned': round(user_hours, 2),

                                'workload_type': '',

                                'wl_value': 0

                            })

                        

                        months_details.append({

                            'year': year,

                            'month': month,

                            'forecast_hours': round(forecast_hours, 2),

                            'assigned_hours': round(assigned_hours, 2),

                            'users': month_users

                        })

                    

                    debug_log(f"Task={task}, Role={role}: forecast={total_forecast:.2f}, assigned={total_assigned:.2f}")

                    

                    if total_assigned > total_forecast + 1:

                        overload = total_assigned - total_forecast

                        debug_log(f"  >>> OVERLOAD! overload={overload:.2f}")

                        

                        # Получаем subject задачи

                        task_subject = task

                        all_assignments = workload_result.get('tree_data', [])

                        for row in all_assignments:

                            if row.get('task_id') == task:

                                task_subject = row.get('task_subject', task)

                                break

                        

                        overloads.append({

                            'task': task,

                            'task_subject': task_subject,

                            'role': role or 'Без роли',

                            'total_forecast': round(total_forecast, 2),

                            'total_assigned': round(total_assigned, 2),

                            'overload': round(overload, 2),

                            'months': months_details,

                            'users': list(all_users_by_task_role.get((task, role), set()))

                        })

                

                debug_log(f"=== STEP 7: RESULTS ===")

                debug_log(f"Overloads found: {len(overloads)}")

                

                # ========== 6. ФОРМИРОВАНИЕ ОТВЕТА ==========

                client_overloads = []

                for o in overloads:

                    client_overloads.append({

                        'task': o['task'],

                        'task_subject': o['task_subject'],

                        'role': o['role'],

                        'total_forecast': o['total_forecast'],

                        'total_assigned': o['total_assigned'],

                        'overload': o['overload'],

                        'months': o['months'],

                        'affected_users': len(o['users'])

                    })



                log(f"Returning {len(client_overloads)} client overloads")



                frappe.response["message"] = {

                    'overloads': client_overloads,

                    'total_overloads': len(client_overloads),

                    'affected_tasks': len(set(o['task'] for o in client_overloads)),

                    'affected_users': sum(o['affected_users'] for o in client_overloads)

                }
